english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something with sexual appeal.
Use this for a person, outfit, or image that is sexually attractive or seductive rather than merely indecent.
Use this when the attraction is explicitly sexual.
Use this for clothes, images, or behaviour that is sexually provocative or cheekily risqué, rather than for general misbehaviour.
Choose this specifically for sexual appeal or an appearance intended to arouse, rather than for ordinary thrills.
Use this when sexual means sexually attractive or suggestive, rather than simply relating to sex.
